title: NexHub 0.5.1 发布
body: 本次更新：软件公告与首次启动引导、Bangumi 登录改用内置浏览器、语言默认跟随系统。应用不内置任何站点，内容来自你导入的源。
bodyEn: This update: in-app announcements and first-launch onboarding, Bangumi sign-in now uses an embedded browser, and language defaults to following the system. The app ships no built-in sites; content comes from the sources you import.

title: 欢迎使用 NexHub
body: NexHub 是四合一媒体聚合客户端（动漫 / 漫画 / 小说 / 影视）。它不内置任何站点，解析能力全部来自可导入的「源」。导入社区维护的源后即可开始浏览。
bodyEn: NexHub is an all-in-one media client (anime / manga / novel / video). It ships no built-in sites; all parsing comes from importable 'sources'. Import a community-maintained source to start browsing.
